notes.title: Fixed the enemy spawn BUG
notes.content: Fixed an enemy spawn BUG that in the past could cause enemies not to spawn under certain special conditions

notes.title: Added two special types of enemies
notes.content:
Added two special types of enemies
[list]
[*] Can use melee weapons to hunt down the player's enemies, note that this enemy is relatively fragile, but very fast moving
[*] An enemy that can shoot at the player with a single-shot weapon that uses a slower ballistic speed
[/list]
